events.title: Apache Ant first released
events.summary: The Apache Jakarta project shipped Ant 1.1 on July 19, 2000 — the first standalone release of the [Java] [XML] build tool.
events.about: Ant runs builds from `build.xml` files — compile [Java], jar artifacts, run tests, copy resources — without Make's platform quirks. It powered Tomcat, early enterprise [Java], and later [Maven]'s ecosystem. Example: `<target name="compile"><javac srcdir="src"/></target>` runs the same on Windows, [macOS], and Linux.

narrative.whyChosen: Ant made cross-platform [Java] builds practical before IDEs owned the workflow.
narrative.whyImportant: [XML]-defined builds became the template [Maven] and [Gradle] later improved upon.
narrative.problemSolved: Building Tomcat on many platforms with Make was fragile; [Java] needed its own portable build tool.
